description: The pins of this baseline: Microsoft's official file, where to download it, its SHA-256, and which of its GPOs the kit applies, in order. Nothing of the file itself is in the repository: scripts/Get-Baselines.py downloads it into the work folder (<work>/baselines), checks the SHA-256 and imports it there (scripts/Import-Baseline.py), and the build stages that data into the image. 'page' is Microsoft's download page (Security Compliance Toolkit), for when the file at 'url' has been replaced.
name: Microsoft Edge v151 Security Baseline
localInstall: Scripts/Baseline-LocalInstall.ps1: LGPO /g for every GPO in the package, sorted by name; no client-side extensions registered.
